evidence_direction_note: V3-EXQ-723 REE-NATIVE J-LENS DISPOSITIONAL-READOUT DIAGNOSTIC (Experiment A of SD-064; experiment_purpose=diagnostic, EXCLUDED from governance scoring; claim_ids=[] -- SD-064 global-workspace claim + MECH-191 signal-legibility referenced for CONTEXT only). Ports Anthropic's J-lens (2026) as a READOUT on the EXISTING all-ON substrate (V3-EXQ-714 ARM_ON, identical to V3-EXQ-719a) -- NO new mechanism, measurement only. Question: does REE have a J-space -- a COMPACT, action-coupled subspace of the latent state that predicts the future committed action above chance while occupying < 10% of latent activity? Per P2 tick logs the full latent vector z_t (concat z_world/z_self/z_harm/z_harm_a) + executed committed_class + a best-effort broadcast 'report' proxy. Readout (per seed, horizons [1, 3, 5], primary_H=3): ridge linear map z_t -> committed_class_{t+H} on a temporal train split; held-out balanced accuracy vs a 200-permutation label null; J-space via SVD of the weight matrix (jspace_dim @ 0.9 energy; jspace_activity_fraction vs the 0.1 compactness ceiling; predictive_retention vs the 0.8 floor). Pre-registered self-route (HYPOTHESIS, NOT a verdict): predictable-above-null + fraction < 0.10 + retention >= 0.80 (majority of seeds) -> compact_action_coupled_subspace_present (raises SD-064 prior; motivates the SD-027 V3 gate retrofit unlocking Experiment B); predictable but diffuse -> no_compact_workspace_diffuse (pluralist reading); under-sampled / no above-null signal -> substrate_not_ready_requeue. Experiment B (workspace-ablation cliff) is SUBSTRATE-BLOCKED (SD-027 boundary gate not built in V3) and is NOT queued. interpretation_label=compact_action_coupled_subspace_present; readiness_met=True. PROMOTES / DEMOTES NOTHING; route to /failure-autopsy for adjudication. Design: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/global_workspace_jlens_plan.md section 2.

interpretation_grid.compact_action_coupled_subspace_present: action predictable above the label-permutation null AND jspace_activity_fraction < 0.10 AND predictive_retention >= 0.80, each on a majority of seeds. REE has a COMPACT, action-coupled, causally-central subspace -- the J-space analogue. HYPOTHESIS (not a verdict): raises the SD-064 (global-workspace) prior and motivates the SD-027 V3 boundary-gate retrofit that unlocks the Experiment B ablation-cliff falsifier. Route to /failure-autopsy for adjudication.
interpretation_grid.no_compact_workspace_diffuse: action IS predictable above null, but the action-predictive structure is DIFFUSE (jspace_activity_fraction >= 0.10 OR predictive_retention < 0.80 on a majority). HYPOTHESIS (not a verdict): evidence toward the SD-027-original pluralist / no-single-workspace reading -- no compact broadcast bottleneck. Route to /failure-autopsy.
interpretation_grid.substrate_not_ready_requeue: under-sampled P2 / too few train pairs / < 2 committed classes, OR NO above-null predictive signal on a majority of seeds (a linear readout that cannot predict the agent's own next action is an undertraining signature, NOT a workspace null). NOT a verdict -- re-queue at a larger P2 budget / more training. Draw NO conclusion about SD-064.

evidence_quality_note: 2026-07-09 (governance, failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-723_2026-07-09 confirmed): adjudicated INCONCLUSIVE. The prior vacuous_pass indexer flag was a schema-collision false positive (diffuse_branch:False in criteria_non_degenerate; fixed upstream by indexer commit ad44202e5b -> now adjudicates 'verified'). But the self-route 'compact_action_coupled_subspace_present' is NOT trustworthy on its own terms: the discrimination gates (jspace_activity_fraction<0.10; predictive_retention>=0.80) are NON-DISCRIMINATIVE -- trivially satisfied by any weak nonzero linear ridge map in a 112-dim latent. Established: committed action is WEAKLY linearly decodable above null (bal_acc 0.35-0.50 vs null_p95 0.21-0.51; seed 43 ~2-class). NOT established: a COMPACT action-coupled workspace. Does NOT raise the SD-064 prior; does NOT greenlight the SD-027 Experiment-B retrofit build. Superseded by V3-EXQ-723a (discriminative compactness vs matched-rank random-subspace baseline + gated broadcast/reactive contrasts) when it runs.
